_설명: 천일문 3권 워크북 Chapter 08 접속사의 Chapter Test를 변형한 것. 심화 9과 접속사 자리에 합쳐 둔다.

points.point: not only A but also B 등 상관접속사

questions.prompt: 다음 중 빈칸에 들어갈 가장 알맞은 접속사를 고르세요.
body: I couldn’t finish my report anymore ________ my laptop broke down.

choices.text: unless
because
before
so that
even though

questions.prompt: 다음 중 빈칸에 들어갈 가장 알맞은 접속사를 고르세요.
body: We cheered for Mina ________ she crossed the finish line.

choices.text: if
until
unless
but
although

questions.point_label: not only A but also B
questions.prompt: 다음 중 빈칸에 들어갈 가장 알맞은 접속사를 고르세요.
body: Jiho not only listened to my worries ________ also gave me good advice.

choices.text: or
nor
and
also
but

questions.prompt: 다음 중 <보기>의 밑줄 친 if와 쓰임이 같은 것을 고르세요.
body: <보기> I’ll take a taxi or subway [[if]] it’s far from my house.

choices.text: I wonder [[if]] Mina lives near the school.
Jiho wasn’t sure [[if]] Sora’s story was true.
Somi asked me [[if]] I could visit her house.
Don’t hesitate to ask me for help [[if]] you need it.
We wanted to know [[if]] we made the teacher upset.

questions.prompt: 다음 중 <보기>의 밑줄 친 as와 의미가 다른 것을 고르세요.
body: <보기> The baby was crying a lot [[as]] he was hungry.

choices.text: [[As]] it was snowing a lot, we decided to stay home.
Mina took the medicine [[as]] the doctor ordered.
Sora was tired before getting home [[as]] it was humid.
I couldn’t keep a promise with my friends [[as]] I was sick.
[[As]] my phone was out of battery, I wasn’t able to answer any calls.

questions.prompt: 우리말과 일치하도록 주어진 단어를 사용하여 문장을 완성하세요.
body: 나는 소라가 집에 있는지 궁금하다. (if, be, home, at)

questions.prompt: 우리말과 일치하도록 주어진 단어를 사용하여 문장을 완성하세요.
body: 너는 마지막 기차가 언제 떠나는지 아니? (when, leave, the last train)

questions.prompt: 우리말과 일치하도록 주어진 단어를 사용하여 문장을 완성하세요.
body: 민지는 그 편지를 읽자마자 울기 시작했다. (she, the letter, as soon as, read)
questions.answer: as soon as she read the letter

questions.prompt: 다음 중 어법상 알맞지 않은 문장을 두 개 고르세요.

choices.text: I wonder what is the title of the movie.
Do you know whether the museum opens on Mondays?
It is strange that the shop has been closed for a month.
Mina saved a lot of money so that she could buy a new camera.
Jiho can’t speak Japanese well despite he has lived in Japan for 5 years.

questions.prompt: 다음 중 어법상 알맞지 않은 문장을 두 개 고르세요.

choices.text: Mina is good at skating as well as swim.
Are both your mother and your father teachers?
She was not studying but chatting with her friends.
Not only teenagers but also adults likes the singer’s new song.
My brother neither looked at me nor talked to me after our fight.

questions.prompt: 다음 글에서 어법상 알맞지 않은 부분을 찾아 바르게 고쳐 쓰세요.
body: We played basketball at lunch break. When we came back to the classroom, it was very hot that we turned on the air conditioner.

questions.prompt: 다음 글에서 어법상 알맞지 않은 부분을 찾아 바르게 고쳐 쓰세요.
body: My family has not visited our grandparents for a while. I asked my dad if could we visit our grandparents for Seollal.
questions.answer: could we visit → we could visit

questions.point_label: not only A but also B의 형태
questions.prompt: 다음 글에서 어법상 알맞지 않은 부분을 찾아 바르게 고쳐 쓰세요.
body: A new model of tablet is coming out! It has not a light body but also a long battery life. I have to save my money to buy it!

questions.point_label: both A and B는 복수 취급
questions.prompt: 다음 글에서 어법상 알맞지 않은 부분을 찾아 바르게 고쳐 쓰세요.
body: After finishing their homework, both Sora and Jiho likes playing board games. Sometimes, they invite their friends over to join them and play together.

questions.prompt: 우리말을 영어로 옮긴 것 중 알맞지 않은 것을 고르세요.

choices.text: 지호가 너무 급하게 먹어서 체했다. → Jiho ate so fast that he had an upset stomach.
너는 누가 내 우산을 가져갔는지 봤니? 나는 그것을 찾을 수 없어. → Did you see who my umbrella took? I can’t find it.
소라가 내 문자를 받았는지가 확실하지 않다. → Whether Sora received my text is uncertain.
나는 우리 이모가 일주일에 몇 편의 영화를 보는지 궁금하다. → I wonder how many movies my aunt watches a week.
너는 자전거를 탈 때, 머리를 보호하기 위해 헬멧을 써야 한다. → Riding a bike, you should wear a helmet so that it can protect your head.
